field_of_view_deg: Panorama: 180 horizontal x 111 vertical; PTZ dome: 2.2-61.8 horizontal x 1.3-36.3 vertical x 2.4-69.2 diagonal
features: 180° AR panorama camera combined with 40x optical zoom PTZ dome
4 panorama sensors stitched into a 180° panoramic image + 1 PTZ dome unit (5 optical modules total)
Two built-in GPUs for deep-learning detection accuracy
AR panorama technology with user-added AR tags
Smart tracking (PTZ auto/manual linked to panorama view)
Triple streams; two channels of HD video display
WDR 120 dB (both cameras), 3D noise reduction, highlight compensation, backlight compensation
Region of interest (ROI) encoding, flexible H.264/H.265
Tripwire crossing, intrusion, and parking detection
Panorama lens mount M16; PTZ dome lens mount: chipset mount
PTZ pan 0-360° continuous rotation, tilt -11° to +90°; pan speed 240°/s, tilt speed 100°/s
300 preset positions, 8 automatic tours (up to 32 presets each), 5 automatic tracking and 5 linear scan slots
7 alarm-in ports, 3 alarm-out ports, 2 audio-in, 2 audio-out, 1 BNC (CVBS) port, 1 RS-485 port
One RJ45 electrical port plus one FC optical port (SFP single-mode single-fiber, 20 km)
Works with Smart NVR for secondary intelligent search, analysis and synopsis of recordings
Maximum power consumption 99 W with WDR + intelligent analysis + illuminator + PTZ all active
ONVIF Profile S/Profile G/Profile T, CGI, and GB/T28181 (dual GB standards) access protocols
release_notes: Minimum illumination differs between the two integrated cameras: panorama camera 0.0005 lux (color) / 0.0002 lux (B/W); PTZ dome camera 0.001 lux F1.4 (color) / 0.0005 lux F1.4 (B/W) / 0 lux with IR illuminator enabled. Recorded night_vision.min_lux/min_lux_color use the panorama-camera values; PTZ dome values are noted here rather than guessed into a single field.
